verdict.rationale: Kushki's docs include a 'Test Data ... Moving to Production' section, which points to a first-party test environment with test data separate from production. The evidence is only a title-level mention, so it does not show how closely the test environment mirrors production or which scenarios the test cards cover. missing for 10: evidence that the sandbox mirrors production, documented test cards for declines, documented test cards for disputes/chargebacks, end-to-end flow testing detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
